svg.title: Trajectory — from administration to full-stack development and applied AI
svg.desc: Step 01 Administration: structure, responsibility, detail (7+ years). Step 02 DAW studies at UOC: Web Application Development. Step 03 splits into Full-Stack (backend, frontend, devops) and Applied AI (agents, automation, prompt design). Step 04 Goal: practical, scalable and well-structured solutions.
svg.text: admin → daw → full-stack + applied ai → goal
